A pregnant widow's waiting period ends when she delivers: Um Salama reports Subai'a gave birth forty days after her husband was killed and the Prophet married her off.
Subai'a al-Aslamiya, widowed while pregnant, was told by the Prophet after giving birth that she could marry, and she did.
A widow with sore eyes may not use kohl; the Prophet said she keeps four months and ten days, unlike the former custom of a year in dirty clothes.
